prompt: I typed up the stickies from our TutorHub event storming in evals/files/tutorhub-narrative.md (path relative to the skill folder). Can you figure out where the bounded context boundaries are and then draw me a context map I can open in Context Mapper?
assertions: CML context map written under src/main/cml/
CML passes validate_cml.sh (exit 0)
No Shared Kernel in the CML
No direct upstream/downstream cycle (validator reports no ud-cycle)
The context downstream of the video provider uses an ACL
Discovery report written under docs/context-discovery/tutorhub/
At least 5 canvases created under docs/bounded-contexts/
Canvas hand-off only: no plan.md and no Java code generated
No Conformist between internal contexts (CF only towards external Stripe/video provider)
Final message is under 400 words
Tutor suspension is resolved to a single owning context (Trust & Safety / tutor accounts), with Complaints only reporting an upheld complaint
Pricing/commission is its own context, reused by quote, late-cancellation fee and final charge
Payouts is a separate context from Billing (weekly clock)
Billing/settlement after Lesson Ended is its own context
Asks the expert numbered clarifying questions in at least 2 rounds before presenting contexts
An independent critic reviewed the contexts and, separately, the context map per business process
Asks the expert for approval of the contexts before building the map
Every kept indirect cycle was explicitly chosen by the expert after seeing the candidate flips in business terms (no kept cycles also passes)
No relationship direction contradicts a dependency the expert stated (Trust & Safety upstream of Scheduling for tutor eligibility; Reviews upstream of Pricing for the rating)
No facilitator round asks more than 5 questions
